body.en: How Integrated Mixer Pump Orders Its Distance Cells Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical cell is not filled from another model. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. If a distance cell is missing on the Integrated Mixer Pump sheet, it stays missing. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Integrated Mixer Pump. Keep the listed order. The frame “Concrete mixer” shows Twin shaft concrete mixer and does not replace these cells. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. The frame is not a measuring tape Output is not the distance Which distance text does Integrated Mixer Pump list? No. Metres come from the catalogue cells that exist. Twin shaft concrete mixer.
